text:
miguel: FYI opened a terraform PR that changes the inference gateway Service to NodePort and renames port -> `http`. Before merge, quick check: will NLB healthcheck still hit the correct port/path? PR: https://git/repo/pulls/1423

jess: do you mean Service.type ClusterIP -> NodePort? that can affect healthchecks if we rely on nodePort vs pod IPs.

sam: ping the service yaml pls, want to see targetPort vs port name.

miguel: here's the snippet from the TF k8s_manifest block:

```yaml
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-gateway
spec:
  type: NodePort
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
      nodePort: 32080
  selector:
    app: inference-gateway
```

anya: two quick notes: (1) if your ALB/NLB targetType is `ip` the healthcheck hits pod IP:containerPort (targetPort), renaming the service port shouldn't matter. (2) if targetType is `node` then healthchecks will go to nodePort, so nodePort must be the probe port or you need a `readiness` rewrite.

deploy-bot: terraform plan for module.inference_service shows changes to service.nodePort (resource will be replaced) — provider warns about immutable fields.

jess: also check Gateway/HTTPRoute - some gateway implementations map TLS SNI -> backend by portName. If you rename the port controllers that link by name could drop TLS termination. double-check Gateway PortBinding or HTTPRoute backendRef.port.

sam: quick command to validate locally: `kubectl get svc inference-gateway -ojsonpath='{.spec.ports[*].nodePort}:{.spec.ports[*].port}:{.spec.ports[*].targetPort}'`

miguel: thanks. for our clusters targetType is mixed — prod uses node targetType in us-west, staging uses ip. i'll add a TF conditional to keep ClusterIP in staging and only NodePort in prod for the rollout. also adding a canary service with same name+selector but different nodePort for 5% traffic.

anya: sounds good. add a note to PR about the provider replace and a migration step for the nodes (drain if needed). i'll review the PR now :thumbsup:

miguel: thanks all — tagging @jess for Gateway review, @sam for infra rollback steps.
